name: TOI-1873
title: TOI-1873: two planets and a candidate, TESS + NEID
notes: Real data: TESS SPOC light curves (13 sectors) as extracted and detrended in EXOTIC examples/toi-3planet, and 37 NEID velocities of the published pyaneti analysis. See public/examples/toi1873/README.md. Free: Rp/R★, i, P, T mid and the mass of each planet, the limb darkening (q1, q2) and the NEID jitter; a/R★ follows from Kepler’s law, orbits circular. Planet d’s period is 900.1885 d / N with N one of the aliases the TESS coverage allows (1, 2, 3, 4, 7), sampled; orbits that cross or are not Hill stable have no prior mass.
